images.title: Ribbon prices on a double number line
images.purpose: Show the price of a length on a double number line: metres on the top line, rupees on the bottom line, 3 m for ₹90, 6 m for ₹180 and 9 m for ₹270, with the arrow x3.
images.composition: Two parallel lines with three ticks each, arrows x3 on the top and on the bottom, and the price of 1 m written beside.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TOP LINE: one horizontal line from x 228 to x 1228 at y 270 with exactly 3 tall tick marks (44 px) at x 428, 728 and 1028 labelled above in 44 px bold 3 m, 6 m and 9 m. BOTTOM LINE: one horizontal line from x 228 to x 1228 at y 500 with exactly 3 tall ticks at the same x positions labelled below in 44 px bold ₹90, ₹180 and ₹270. ARROWS: one curved arrow above the top line from the 3 m tick to the 9 m tick with the label ×3 in a teal #0072B2 rounded box 100 by 50 px (x 678 to 778, y 150 to 200); one curved arrow below the bottom line from ₹90 to ₹270 with the label ×3 in a teal box (x 678 to 778, y 600 to 650). A thin dashed vertical line joins each top tick to the bottom tick under it. PRICE OF 1 m: an amber #E69F00 rounded box 560 by 70 px (x 448 to 1008, y 690 to 760) with the text 90 ÷ 3 = ₹30 for 1 m in 44 px bold. In all: 2 lines, 6 ticks, 2 arrows, 1 price box. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 3 ticks on either line
images.takeaway: Multiply the metres and the price by the same number.
images.description: A double number line with 3 m, 6 m and 9 m over ₹90, ₹180 and ₹270, the arrow ×3 and 90 ÷ 3 = ₹30 for 1 m.
images.context: Concept image for Price of a Length: Double Number Line. It follows the idea of the cloth double number line in your maths book (metres over rupees) and shows the concept's own example, ribbon at ₹90 for 3 m (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Go along both lines together. The slip to watch: adding ₹90 each time instead of multiplying.
